stem.text: A student adds $3\,\text{mol}$ of acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ to an excess of $\text{I}^{-}$ ions.
The chromium is all reduced to $\text{Cr}^{3+}$ and $\text{I}^{-}$ ions are oxidised to $\text{I}_2$.
The $\text{I}_2$ released is reduced back to $\text{I}^{-}$ ions by $X\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{S}_2\text{O}_3^{2-}$ ions.
$1\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{I}_2$ is reduced by $2\,\text{mol}$ of $\text{S}_2\text{O}_3^{2-}$ ions.
